interpretation: Rate-integral speed estimates on a shared conserved EOS trajectory; no BVP
scaling: At fixed a_0plus, T and mu scale as nB^(1/3), I2 as nB^(4/3); ratios are invariant
quadrature_composition: Common target grid; actual upstream composition residual is saved per row

classification.no_front: P_0minus+B < cold equilibrium pressure at conserved nB
classification.no_cold_interface: P_0minus+B > cold a=1 pressure at conserved nB
classification.physical: A unique cold composition lies strictly between 0 and 1
classification.eos_failure: The branch-validated upstream solver did not return a state

upstream_metadata.scope: Cold interface and upstream states only; no BVP or velocity solve
upstream_metadata.scan_limitation: Finite density scan; narrower unbracketed intervals are not excluded
upstream_metadata.seed_recovery_policy: Retry original validator once with supplemental seeds; unchanged agreement/residual tolerances; original failures cached
